easy.q: According to legend, how many years did the Trojan War last?
easy.fact: Homer's Iliad covers just a few weeks in the war's final year.

easy.q: How many judges sat on the panel in the first season of American Idol?
easy.fact: Simon Cowell, Paula Abdul and Randy Jackson judged the first season in 2002.

easy.q: How many standard time zones cover the contiguous 48 U.S. states?
easy.fact: Eastern, Central, Mountain and Pacific; Alaska and Hawaii add two more.

easy.q: How many numbered balls get racked at the start of a game of 8-ball pool?
easy.fact: Balls 1 through 7 are solids, and 9 through 15 are stripes.

easy.q: How many members are in the Backstreet Boys?
easy.fact: Their 1999 album Millennium sold over 1.1 million copies in its first week.

medium.q: How many full years did Queen Victoria reign over Britain?
medium.fact: She reigned from 1837 to 1901, longer than any British monarch before her.

medium.q: How many times did HBO's Succession win the Emmy for Outstanding Drama Series?
medium.fact: Its last win came for its fourth and final season.

medium.q: How long is Egypt's Suez Canal, to the nearest 10 miles?
medium.fact: It opened in 1869 and has no locks.

medium.q: How far is the NBA 3-point line from the basket at the top of the arc, to the nearest foot?
medium.fact: It's exactly 23 feet 9 inches, shrinking to 22 feet in the corners.

medium.q: How many seasons of Glee aired on Fox?
medium.fact: The Glee cast has more than 200 entries on the Billboard Hot 100.

hard.q: In what year was the USS Constitution, "Old Ironsides," launched?
hard.fact: It's the world's oldest commissioned warship still afloat.

hard.q: How many episodes of Cheers aired over its 11 seasons?
hard.fact: Its spinoff Frasier ran another 264 episodes.

hard.q: How deep is Lake Tahoe at its deepest, in feet?
hard.fact: It's the second-deepest lake in the U.S., behind Oregon's Crater Lake.

hard.q: How many Olympic gold medals did Carl Lewis win?
hard.fact: He won the long jump at four straight Olympics, 1984 to 1996.
